hook.text: Bronze, silver, gold. Three layers that organize a lakehouse from raw chaos to business-ready insights.

buildup.text: Bronze stores raw, unprocessed data. Silver applies cleaning and enrichment. Gold serves curated business tables.

discovery.text: Each layer improves data quality progressively. If gold breaks, you reprocess from silver, not from scratch.

twist.text: Not every pipeline needs all three layers. Simple sources may skip silver and go directly from bronze to gold.

climax.text: The medallion pattern gives teams a shared vocabulary for data quality tiers across the entire organization.

punchline.text: Bronze: raw. Silver: clean. Gold: trusted. Simple layers, clear purpose.

quiz.question: What does the gold layer in medallion architecture contain?
